slots.title: Bitcoin whale that sat through the March 2020 crash moves $378 million
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: A bitcoin whale that received coins days before the Covid crash and sat through it has moved millions on-chain.

slots.title: Tokenized SanDisk bets saw more liquidations than XRP as Asia’s chip rout wipes out $800 million
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: About $800 million in leveraged positions were wiped out over 24 hours, 86% of them bullish. Chip-stock contracts on crypto exchanges took a chunk of the damage.

slots.title: Meta claims new Muse Wonder AI models rival OpenAI, Anthropic
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: Meta co-founder Mark Zuckerberg said its newest models are a step toward “personal superintelligence.”

slots.title: Palantir's Europe head warns the region is 'missing the boat' on AI just as it did with the internet
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The Palantir UK chief said the U.S. is racing ahead on enterprise AI while Europe hesitates, and explained why he thinks the company faces intense political attacks.

slots.title: FTX’s crypto mining venture is now used to advance AI
slots.author: Cointelegraph
slots.summary: The defunct exchange acquired a 20% stake in Genesis Digital Assets before FTX declared bankruptcy in November 2022.
slots.reason: A major development affecting both AI and blockchain

slots.title: Once-largest Ethereum NFT marketplace Blur is shutting down after volumes collapse 99%
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Blur will close its website on Nov. 12 after monthly trading fell from about $1.43 billion at its 2023 peak to under $7 million, ten days after sister project Blast announced its own shutdown.
slots.reason: Outside your usual reads — worth a skim
